summary: design-review.md is internally consistent with proposal.md, design.md, grill.md, and both spec deltas, and it stays within the constitution's constraints (Rust 2021 root crate, no secret reads, no target-checkout writes, additive bootstrap JSON). It correctly resolves five material branches without inventing new scope: no strict coupling to the target doctor JSON, focus booleans stay false until verified focus exists, can_query_windows determinism is deferred to a pinned test-plan probe, source_overlay treated as static acceptance metadata, and abs_pointer derived locally rather than circularly from the target CapabilityMap. Open Questions is None and no pre-ADR document edits are required, so the design-review gate can proceed to adr.md. Secret-leakage risk is well controlled: the design and review both restrict env reporting to presence booleans and explicitly exclude DBus session bus addresses and .secrets.local.env. No model/effort policy issues. The review also surfaces a genuinely valuable catch (the stale no-live-x11-probes bootstrap check becoming false once read-only probes are added) and routes it correctly to test-plan/tasks.
